discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 5af3770c6f. `generatePool` now owns a `CallMeter` that the completer fills as chunks arrive, so the usage, cost and first token a provider reported survive a failed stream, a mid-stream throw, the deadline and a stale abort, and a refused reasoning-off attempt and its retry are summed as one call. A failed call is also recorded under the planner's own provider and model instead of the chat's.

discussion_comments.comment_body:
These stream retries introduce a few concerns:

- A stream error can happen after Claude Code has successfully edited files or run commands. Retrying the same request can repeat those actions. Could we preserve the existing guard against retrying after provider-owned tools have executed?

- Immediate retries exhaust during brief outages that previously recovered with backoff. Should we add backoff rertries

- [more just a thought, not an issue] Tool activity and subsequent text stay buffered until completion. Could provider-owned tools retain live progress here? 

- [telemetry] When a failed stream retries without emitting a finish event, its Langfuse span never closes or exports, hiding that attempt from the trace. Could it close before the next attempt starts?

discussion_comments.comment_body:
> A stream error can happen after Claude Code has successfully edited files or run commands. Retrying the same request can repeat those actions. Could we preserve the existing guard against retrying after provider-owned tools have executed?

AI SDK buffers local tool calls until the attempt succeeds. If the stream fails, it discards those buffered calls before retrying. Local tools from earlier completed steps aren’t replayed either. The only exception is claude code because it's through a proxy and it's a gap that their docs documented so no a bug introduced by us.

> Immediate retries exhaust during brief outages that previously recovered with backoff. Should we add backoff rertries

i have talked to jose and check the ai sdk docs. We would only retries when the error is marked as retryable. If it's not safe to retry immediately we won't 

> [more just a thought, not an issue] Tool activity and subsequent text stay buffered until completion. Could provider-owned tools retain live progress here?

Claude Code session recovery belongs primarily in ai-sdk-provider-claude-code: it owns the session, tool execution, and how subsequent calls resume after interruption. We should persist the provider’s session identity and respect its recovery contract, rather than reconstructing Claude Code’s internal tool state.

discussion_comments.comment_body: Pushed in 4a4844d6e8 — added `["outputTokens", "reasoning"]` to `REASONING_TOKEN_PATHS` and a regression test (`subtracts AI SDK v4's nested outputTokens.reasoning from outputTokens`) covering this exact shape. Full `llms` suite still green (886 passed).

**[P2] Preserve completed provider-tool activity.** Provider-executed tools live in `metadata.modelToolActivities`, so this condition also matches a retry that executes a provider tool, emits text, then errors. Recording only `first` discards the completed tool result from conversation history. Please preserve the retry's completed activity as well.

Fixed — request preparation is now split from issuing, and recovery prepares the compacted request once, then re-issues it under the shared bounded provider-retry policy. Compaction (notices, telemetry, summarizer) runs once regardless of retries; exhaustion surfaces the provider error with the truncated turn kept. Tests cover the recovered case (exactly one overflowRecovery prepare, same compacted messages each attempt) and exhaustion.
